policies.bounds: max text 8000 UTF-8 bytes; max metadata including text and cve_id 39000 bytes; list overflow counts explicit; text truncation explicit
policies.cohort: exact pinned CVEProject 2026 PUBLISHED and REJECTED partitions
policies.cvss: CNA then ADP; NVD only when both have no CVSS. Highest version within provider tier, deterministic provider tie-break. Other CVE assessments retained where bounded.
policies.cwe: CNA plus ADP; NVD fallback if no explicit CWE code
policies.description: CNA English preferred; NVD fallback only if absent
policies.legacy_enrichment: no prior inferred classification or specialized exploit-index mappings retained
policies.nvd_configurations: boolean AND/OR/negate preserved; vulnerable:false is not converted to globally unaffected
policies.remediation: CNA plus ADP solutions and workarounds; has_solution_guidance and has_workaround_guidance indicate source field presence, not availability of a working fix
policies.version_status: status changes preserved in explicit source rules; defaults only outside listed entries; unaffected does not mean fixed
